notes.title: “Like Dreamer” Ver2.11 Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Like Dreamer.
We are pleased to announce the Ver2.11 update for Like Dreamer.

In this version, the following changes have been made:

・Adjusted the replay and ranking UI when using the Chinese language setting.

notes.title: “Like Dreamer” Ver2.10 Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Like Dreamer.
We are pleased to announce the Ver2.10 update for Like Dreamer.

In this version, the following changes have been made:

・Added support for Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
・Fixed some English text.
・Fixed some UI display issues.
・Corrected text in some gallery illustrations.

notes.title: "Like Dreamer" Ver. 2.04 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Like Dreamer.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 2.04 update of Like Dreamer.

In this version, we have made the following changes.

・Added Sound type (Sound API) to options.

notes.title: "Like Dreamer" Ver. 2.03 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Like Dreamer.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 2.03 update of Like Dreamer.

In this version, we have made the following changes.

・Implementation of functionality to automatically change button type with controller input.
・Fixed a problem that “Scores have been sent to the leaderboard.” was displayed in an inappropriate state.

notes.title: "Like Dreamer" Ver. 2.02 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Like Dreamer.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 2.02 update of Like Dreamer.

In this version, we have made the following changes.

・Added a specification that a demo play is played after a certain amount of time on the title screen.
　The opening and some demo plays are repeated after each playback.
・Added "SteamDeck" button type to key configurations.
　Caution! After the update, the game may load with different settings than before.
・Long pressing a directional button now sends the item automatically.
・Added a screen to confirm whether or not to send scores to the online ranking after completing a specific game mode.
・Changed the selection method of ranking.
・When changing the language of configuration, language data is loaded when the screen is switched.
・Fixed a problem that the game speed may become unstable at the start of the game.
・Fixed some other problems.

notes.title: "Like Dreamer" Ver. 2.01 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Like Dreamer.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 2.01 update of Like Dreamer.

In this version, we have made the following changes.

Fixed a problem in which the selection items were misaligned when returning to the title menu.
Fixed a problem with the Best display on the results screen of the speedrun.

notes.title: "Like Dreamer" Ver2.00 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Like Dreamer.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 2.00 update of Like Dreamer.

In this version, we have made the following changes.


Extra stage (unlocked by clearing the Trial Tour on any difficulty level)

Addition of Chaos difficulty (unlocked by clearing the trial tour on Nightmare)

Addition of Enemy List (selectable from the gallery screen)

Addition and deletion of gallery illustrations (deletion of illustrations to add more illustrations and add enemy list)

English wording has been changed to be the same as the Nintendo Switch version.


The clear mark display in the stage select screen has been merged into a single display for each character.

Adjusted the color of some graphics such as items and enemy bullets.

Relaxed the conditions for hidden 1-ups on the way to the 8th stage (1-ups now appear even if a specific enemy appears while a bomb is being used).

Added a 1-up only in Boss Rush mode.

Revised specifications and manual for Stage 9 conditions.

Removed misplaced help carriers.

Fixed a bug in the Best display of the result screen in Speedrun.

Fixed a bug that scores in Help mode were sent to the rankings.

Added version information to the ranking.

Fixed a bug in which the opening effect display was misaligned under certain conditions.

Fixed the text of some gallery illustrations.

Revision of manual.

Revised end credits.

notes.title: Notice of "Like Dreamer" ver2.00 Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Like Dreamer.

A new version of Like Dreamer, ver 2.00, will be updated soon.
This update will implement elements added in the recently released Nintendo Switch version, such as "Extra Stage", "Difficulty Chaos", and "Enemy List".

For the sake of reproducibility, we have made the following changes to the update
Replays saved in previous versions of the game will no longer be able to be replayed.
If you have important replay data, we apologize for the inconvenience,
We apologize for the inconvenience, but we recommend that you save important replay data separately by video recording or other means.
Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Like Dreamer Ver. 1.13 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Like Dreamer.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 1.13 update of Like Dreamer.

The following changes have been made in this version.

Lighter graphic output process.
The English name of SNS in the game has been unified to "Bulletalk".
Fixed a problem in which some enemies were difficult to see while launching bombs.

notes.title: Like Dreamer Ver. 1.12 update
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that "Like Dreamer" has been updated to version 1.12.

This update includes the following changes

Revised some parts of the manual
Fixed a bug that each unlock does not refer to clear help mode.
Adjusted the stage start position in practice mode for stage 9.
Fixed a problem with the boss timer displaying seconds under a comma.
Fixed a bug in the results screen display.

notes.title: Like Dreamer Ver. 1.11 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Like Dreamer.
We have updated the game to fix several bugs and improve the game.

Fixed an issue where the Pause screen could not be displayed when speedrun is enabled in Practice mode.
Fixed an issue where the leaderboard send message would appear on the results screen under inappropriate circumstances.
Added 6 seconds of invincibility time after destroying a boss.

Due to the above fixes, we apologize that replays saved prior to 1.10 that were hit by return fire after a boss was destroyed will no longer replay correctly.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Like Dreamer Ver. 1.10 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Like Dreamer".
We have just implemented the Ver. 1.10 update which includes major changes.

Below are the changes.

Steam API support
Support for Steam Achievements
Steam Global Leaderboard ranking
Leaderboard registration process has been added to the results screen upon completion of each trial mode.
Changed in-game text from ShiftJIS to UTF-8.
Changed the image of the startup screen.
Reorganized the ending structure and added credits.
Changed the sound effect of "Fever MAX" when manual fever is selected.
Removed meaningless score display that occurs during boss bonuses.
Fixed an unstable gauge decrease during Buzz Fever only in Speed Run mode.

Speed Run Mode ranking will be reset once with the modification of Speed Run Mode. We apologize for any inconvenience caused. We also apologize that replays of Speedrun Mode saved in versions prior to Ver. 1.10beta will no longer play properly.

Ver. 1.10beta is now closed to the public.
We would like to thank all those who participated in the beta test of Ver1.10beta.

notes.title: Like Dreamer Ver. 1.05 update
notes.content:
Like Dreamer has been updated to Ver. 1.05.
A bug has been identified that could impair the playability of the game and has been fixed.

Fixed a bug in which bombs immediately after being hit by a bullet would not trigger during Fever activation.

Replays prior to Ver. 1.04 that attempted to use a bomb immediately after being hit during Fever will no longer play correctly. We apologize for the inconvenience.

[ Postscript ]
As the correction was not made correctly, the file was replaced with the correct one in a hurry.
We apologize for any inconvenience.

notes.title: Like Dreamer Ver. 1.04 update
notes.content:
Like Dreamer was updated to Ver. 1.04.
Minor corrections were made.

Corrected some English expressions.

notes.title: Like Dreamer Ver. 1.03 update
notes.content:
Like Dreamer has been updated to version 1.03.

Fixed a bug in the counter mode so that the return fire does not occur when the number of likes is 0.
Fixed a display error in the practice menu under certain conditions.
Fixed a problem in stage 6 where too many normal enemies would appear during the mid-boss battle if certain enemies were allowed to survive.
Changed the format of BGM files.

By changing the BGM file format, we expect to improve the "some BGMs do not play properly" problem that was reported in some environments.
We apologize that replay data saved before 1.02 may not play properly if it interferes with the modified parts.

notes.title: Like Dreamer Ver. 1.02 update
notes.content:
Like Dreamer was updated to Ver1.02.
Fixed a new bug identified in Ver1.01.

Fixed an issue where bomb barriers were not triggered correctly on certain bosses when shields were destroyed.
We apologize that replays saved before Ver. 1.01 may not be able to reproduce the bosses correctly.

[2022/07/26]
Corrected the version display in the status bar to be correct.

notes.title: Like Dreamer Ver. 1.01 update
notes.content:
Like Dreamer has been updated to Ver. 1.01.
Fixed several bugs, including a fatal one.

Fixed a bug that caused the game screen to become inoperable when selecting key configurations from the pause menu, preventing the user from returning to the game screen

Fixed an issue that caused the bomb barrier to behave erratically when using the Yuri B bomb on certain bosses.
Apologies that replays saved with 1.00 may not be able to correctly reproduce replays regarding the relevant equipment and the relevant bosses.
